claim: SmolLM-Corpus bundles three subsets totalling 236.98M rows and 673 GB: cosmopedia-v2 (39.1M rows), fineweb-edu-dedup (190M rows) and python-edu (7.68M rows).
stance_target: The on-disk footprint of the corpora a 9B-token mix would draw from, which determines local storage requirements for the CMP 170HX box
quoted_support: Subset (3): cosmopedia-v2 39.1M rows, fineweb-edu-dedup 190M rows, python-edu 7.68M rows... Number of rows: 236,980,453. Total file size: 673 GB.

claim: The deduplicated FineWeb-Edu subset contains 220 billion tokens, roughly one sixth of the full 1.3T-token FineWeb-Edu release.
stance_target: Whether deduplication materially shrinks the available web token pool for a small run
quoted_support: FineWeb-Edu-Dedup is a deduplicated subset of the FineWeb-Edu dataset, containing 220 billion tokens of educational web pages.

claim: The python-edu subset consists of Python files scored 4 or more by an educational code model, extracted from the-stack-v2-train with file contents pulled from Software Heritage's S3 bucket to satisfy licence compliance.
stance_target: Whether a code component can be sourced without redistributing licensed source files
quoted_support: The python-edu subset consists of Python files that were scored 4 or more by the educational code model. The files were extracted from the stack-v2-train dataset. The file contents are downloaded from Software Heritage's S3 bucket to ensure data compliance.

claim: cosmopedia-v2 is a synthetic corpus of over 39 million textbooks, blog posts and stories generated by Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 from web seed samples, and is the only subset with a token_length field rather than token_count.
stance_target: Whether synthetic data is a viable substitute for scarce high-quality tokens at small scale
quoted_support: Cosmopedia v2 is an enhanced version of Cosmopedia, the largest synthetic dataset for pre-training, consisting of over 39 million textbooks, blog posts, and stories generated by Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1.

claim: Stack-Edu is not itself a subset of SmolLM-Corpus; only the python-edu Python slice is included, so Stack-Edu's ~125B-token figure must be sourced from the SmolLM2 paper rather than this dataset card.
stance_target: Any assumption that SmolLM-Corpus can substitute for the Stack-Edu dataset release across all 15 languages
quoted_support: Subset (3): cosmopedia-v2, fineweb-edu-dedup, python-edu. The python-edu subset consists of Python files... extracted from the stack-v2-train dataset.
